messages.content: Generate a DNA sequence with 100 bases including more G (Guanine) and C (Cytosine).

function.name: generate_DNA_sequence
function.description: Generate a random DNA sequence with a specific length and nucleotide preference.

length.description: The length of the DNA sequence to be generated.

preferences.description: Preferred nucleotides to include more frequently in the DNA sequence.

Preferences should be an array of strings: "A", "T", "C", "G". They want more G and C, so I should include G and C in preferences. The tool likely generates a random sequence with those nucleotides included more frequently. I need to specify length=100 and preferences=["G", "C"]? But the preferences array is for preferred nucleotides to include more frequently. The description says "Preferred nucleotides to include more frequently in the DNA sequence." So I can set preferences as ["G", "C"] to bias towards G and C. However, the tool might require all four nucleotides? The enum includes A, T, C, G. I can provide just G and C. Let's try.
